thread:
Marco: FYI Orchid Legal wants to POC their custom oracle model 'orchid-legal-11b' next month. They want INT8 runtime, embeddings for similarity search, and SSO via SAML. Can we confirm variant compatibility and any enterprise blockers?
Lia: High level: 11B->INT8 usually OK but depends on original weight layout and whether it uses grouped linear ops. Need model.tar and config. Also check tokenizer; legal models often have custom tokens for statutes.
Priya: Regs/security: they require SOC2 + SAML SSO + DLP on logs. If hosting, we can use our dedicated tenancy + BYOK for KMS. Kim do we support DLP redaction for debug logs?
Kim: We have log redaction hooks but not full DLP scanning out of the box. For PHI/PII we can enable redaction patterns and route raw debug logs to customer-managed S3 in Private deployments. Will need legal to countersign appendix.
Jordan: Perf ask: they want 95th <300ms on short queries (<=80 tokens) at 15 qps steady, 40 qps bursts. If INT8 runtime on A100 it'll usually meet that with 2 nodes in Dedicated. For embeddings (dense vectors) we should separate the workloads or tune batching differently.
Ravi: Ops notes  recommend two stacks: 1) Hosted Dedicated quick-start (no infra onboarding) with limited BYOK+SAML via proxy, 2) Private in-customer VPC for full control (takes ~3 weeks). Which do they prefer?
Marco: They prefer Private but want a fast demo first. So propose Hosted Dedicated POC then Private for production.
Lia: Request from SE: please ask them for (a) tokenizer.json, (b) model weights (or a hash + source), (c) 100 sample docs (range of short/legal long forms). If tokenizer missing we map to our legal-11b tokenizer but must warn on token count changes.
Priya: Compliance: Need to know data residency (EU/US). Also they asked for SLA clause for data deletion within 30 days of contract end. That affects retention hooks.
Kim: Confirmed we can implement deletion hooks but for Private it's customer-managed. For Hosted we can provide deletion + cert of deletion for an extra fee.
Jordan: Suggest perf plan: run perf sweep with these knobs:
```
# quick perf runner
python runner.py --model orchid-legal-11b-int8 --ctx 128 --batch 1 --steps 150 --measure all
```
We'll capture p50/p95/p99 and token cost.
Ravi: Autoscale suggestion for Hosted Ded: min_nodes=1, target_util=0.65, max_nodes=3, sustain_burst=60s. For embeddings route to a separate pool with higher batch sizes.
Marco: Commercial: ask @finance-bot for two pricing lines: hosted-dedicated POC rate (30 day) and private onboarding + monthly.
finance-bot: Draft pricing: Hosted POC 30d = $18k (trial rate, up to 50k tokens/day) + overage. Private onboarding = $25k setup + $9k/mo infra + per-token runtime. Final quote pending exact token estimates.
Lia: Note on quant: if weights use custom fused kernels we may need conversion script; conversion can add 2-3 days. Also INT8 can increase memory but reduce compute; check peak GPU memory.
Priya: Security questionnaire timeline: they want answers in 5 business days. Kim/Jordan can you coordinate?
Kim: I'll take the questionnaire. Need SAML SP metadata and legal contact.
Jordan: I'll run an initial perf sweep on a small sample after we get tokens and post results in this thread. Expect results within 48h of assets.
Marco: Good. I'll reply to their AE with asset checklist and ask for SAML metadata + residency + sample bundle. Schedule tech call Tues.
Lia: If tokenizer shows many OOV tokens we may recommend retraining tokenizer or using controlled detokenization which could affect cost. Flagging now.
Ravi: I'll open ticket INF-4875 (Orchid POC) and assign SE/infra/security.
infra-bot: ticket INF-4875 created and assigned to Lia (ml-eng), Jordan (perf), Kim (security). Due 2026-04-09.
Marco: Thanks team. Priya please capture any legal clauses they require so we can loop legal early.
Priya: Will do. :ok_hand:
